methodology.loss: Mean squared midpoint displacement divided by fixed nominal amplitude squared
methodology.memory: Peak process RSS including compilation/imports and allocator caches. Additional peak subtracts post-compilation warmup high-water mark.
methodology.timing: First-use compilation/warmup recorded separately from steady-state forward/backward. Main runs permit disk caches. Cache-disabled startup measured separately.
methodology.current: Existing simulate_string() at the matched fixed benchmark grid, not production default 512x oversampling.
methodology.aborted_runs: Stopped above 6 GiB RSS; observed peak is a lower bound, not a completed forward/backward measurement.
methodology.repeats: Median of three fresh-process trials per compiled method and duration.
methodology.compile_scope: One recurrence step; time loop and 128-step checkpoint wrapper remain Python.

validation.short_outputs: Every worker compares 64-step compiled and eager outputs, rtol=1e-8, atol=1e-12.
validation.short_gradients: Every differentiable worker compares compiled/eager gradients, rtol=1e-6, atol=1e-9.
validation.full_run_losses: Every run agrees with previous eager benchmark to atol=1e-12.
validation.gradient_reference: Previous eager reentrant checkpoint benchmark, including full 4 seconds.
